values.value: 1. Open the Draft renewal Quote {primaryRecordId}. 2. Confirm contract end date and current quote status (parent contract end already past). 3. Either submit for approval and activate, or void the quote and create a fresh one with current pricing. 4. If voiding: ensure no downstream Orders were already created against this draft. 5. Inspect the renewal automation (SBQQ__RenewalForecast__c on the contract) — if it's misfiring, log a backlog task.
